purpose: exploratory sensitivity to a count-derived chemical weight assumption, not measured functional conductance
input: same new 112 sequences and data split as generalization stage; previously inspected, hence exploratory
graphs: real and five prior directed degree-preserving rewires; fixed real gap; random source signs seeds 7/17/27
weights: real chemical edges use log(1+EM section counts); in each rewired graph preserve per-source multiset of counts and randomly assign it to that source's new targets with deterministic seed 92000+graph seed; one common max incoming weighted degree across six graphs normalizes all
inputs_outputs: AFDL/AFDR input; RIA-only and all-node readout; train 64, validate 16, test 32
method: Heun dt .025; per-sample-penalty ridge and same penalty candidates as generalization
limitations: EM counts not measured function, signs random, gap unaltered, assigning count to rewired target is artificial; one count transform; no closed loop or animal inference
